findings.title: Public S3 Bucket Exposure
findings.description: An S3 bucket has been found publicly accessible, exposing sensitive customer data including PII and financial records. The bucket contains backups dating back 6 months with no access logging enabled.

findings.title: Unauthenticated API Endpoint
findings.description: A critical API endpoint is accessible without authentication, allowing unauthorized data access to user profiles and transaction records. No rate limiting or IP whitelisting is configured.

findings.title: Brute Force Attack Detected
findings.description: Multiple failed login attempts detected on admin panel from suspicious IP addresses across 3 geographic regions. Over 5000 attempts recorded in the past hour.

findings.title: Unencrypted Database Connection
findings.description: Database connections are being made without SSL/TLS encryption, risking data interception during transit. All application servers are affected by this misconfiguration.

findings.title: Outdated SSL Certificate
findings.description: SSL certificate on CDN domain expires in 7 days. Renewal is required immediately to prevent service disruption and security warnings for end users.

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
findings.description: XSS vulnerability found in user input fields on profile and comments pages allowing script injection. Unvalidated user input is rendered without proper sanitization.

findings.title: Missing DMARC Record
findings.description: No DMARC DNS record found for the domain, making it vulnerable to email spoofing and phishing attacks against the organization.

findings.title: Open RDP Port Detected
findings.description: RDP port 3389 is open to the public internet on a critical server, creating risk of remote exploitation and unauthorized access to the internal network.
